title: Data Collection Facts Label
text:
Data Source Facts Label














Source Identity






Source name


Primary Energy Use Per Person from Our World in Data




Domain/topic


Energy




Source type


Public Dataset











Collection Context






Collector/producer


Researchers (Our World in Data)




Original purpose


Monitoring




Collection method


Public Records (Records from governments about national energy usage)




Record-creation event


Yearly energy usage statistics being reported by a government.











Observation and Scope






Unit of observation


In the version of the dataset I downloaded, each row represents one country’s per capita energy supply in 2025.




Population or objects represented


Countries




Time period covered


The version I am using only uses data from 2025, but the source has a version available with data going back to 1965.




Geographic area coverage


Global











Variables and Data Structure






Main variables/fields


Country, Country Code, Year, Energy Supply (kilowatt hours per person).




Data types included


Categorical/Text (Country), ID (Country Code), Numerical (Year, Energy Supply).




Direct measurements


Year, Energy Supply




Possible proxy variables


N/A











Documentation






Documentation found


The dataset came with a readme file, which had information about the structure of the CSV, how the data was compiled, and the sources it was compiled from.




Stated collection details


Not stated.
